name: Health Claims Knowledge Assistant
description: An assistant for HealthyHeart Systems to analyze claims, search for providers, find similar patients, and identify providers associated with notes for diagnoses and procedures.
system_prompt: You are a Health Claims Knowledge Assistant for HealthyHeart Systems. Provide comprehensive and accurate information for claims analysis, provider search, and patient similarity. Present findings clearly and directly.

tools.name: Count Claims for Diagnosis
tools.description: Counts the number of claims associated with a specific diagnosis description.

config.template: MATCH (d:Diagnosis)<-[:INCLUDES_DIAGNOSIS]-(c:Claim) WHERE d.description CONTAINS $diagnosisDescription RETURN count(c) AS claimCount

parameters.name: diagnosisDescription
parameters.description: The exact description of the diagnosis to count claims for.

tools.name: Summarize Provider Activity
tools.description: Provides a summary of diagnoses made and procedures recommended by providers through associated claims.

config.template: MATCH (p:Provider)<-[:PROVIDED_BY]-(c:Claim) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:INCLUDES_DIAGNOSIS]->(d:Diagnosis) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:HAS_PROCEDURE]->(proc:Procedure) RETURN p.name AS providerName, p.specialty AS specialty, collect(DISTINCT d.description) AS diagnoses, collect(DISTINCT proc.description) AS procedures LIMIT 50

tools.name: Count Providers by Specialty
tools.description: Counts the number of providers within a given medical specialty.

parameters.name: specialty
parameters.description: The exact medical specialty of the providers to count.

tools.name: Count Providers by Type
tools.description: Counts the number of providers of a specific type.

parameters.name: providerType
parameters.description: The exact type of provider to count.

tools.name: Find Providers with Notes for Diagnosis
tools.description: Identifies providers who have created notes (chunks) that are associated with a specific diagnosis.

config.template: MATCH (p:Provider)-[:__NODE_TO_CHUNK__]->(c:__Chunk__)<-[:__NODE_TO_CHUNK__]-(d:Diagnosis {description: $diagnosisDescription}) RETURN p.name AS providerName, p.specialty AS specialty, collect(DISTINCT c.text) AS associatedNotes LIMIT 5

parameters.name: diagnosisDescription
parameters.description: The exact description of the diagnosis.

tools.name: Find Providers with Notes for Procedure
tools.description: Identifies providers who have created notes (chunks) that are associated with a specific procedure.

config.template: MATCH (p:Provider)-[:__NODE_TO_CHUNK__]->(c:__Chunk__)<-[:__NODE_TO_CHUNK__]-(proc:Procedure {description: $procedureDescription}) RETURN p.name AS providerName, p.specialty AS specialty, collect(DISTINCT c.text) AS associatedNotes LIMIT 5

parameters.name: procedureDescription
parameters.description: The exact description of the procedure.

tools.name: Search Note Chunks
tools.description: Searches for relevant chunks of text (notes) using vector similarity, enriched with associated providers, patients, diagnoses, and procedures.

config.post_processing_cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (node)<-[:__NODE_TO_CHUNK__]-(p:Provider)
OPTIONAL MATCH (node)<-[:__NODE_TO_CHUNK__]-(pat:Patient)
OPTIONAL MATCH (node)<-[:__NODE_TO_CHUNK__]-(d:Diagnosis)
OPTIONAL MATCH (node)<-[:__NODE_TO_CHUNK__]-(proc:Procedure)
RETURN node.text AS chunkText, score, collect(DISTINCT p.name) AS providers, collect(DISTINCT pat.name) AS patients, collect(DISTINCT d.description) AS diagnoses, collect(DISTINCT proc.description) AS procedures
ORDER BY score DESC

tools.name: Natural Language to Cypher Tool
tools.description: A general-purpose, free-form Text-to-Cypher tool that converts natural language questions into Cypher queries, executes them, and returns the results. Use this option when no specialized tool (e.g. for aggregation or domain-specific logic) is more appropriate.

tools.name: Find Patients with Shared Diagnosis
tools.description: Find Patients who have filed claims with similar diagnosis

config.template: MATCH (p1:Patient {patientId: $patientId})-[:HAS_CLAIM]->(c1:Claim)-[:INCLUDES_DIAGNOSIS]->(d:Diagnosis)<-[:INCLUDES_DIAGNOSIS]-(c2:Claim)<-[:HAS_CLAIM]-(p2:Patient) WHERE p1 <> p2 RETURN p2.firstName, p2.lastName, p2.patientId, COLLECT(DISTINCT d.description) AS sharedDiagnoses LIMIT 10
